summary: Hard depends-on: FEAT-0017 may force a later landing than necessary.
detail: FEAT-0021 lists depends-on: FEAT-0009, FEAT-0016, FEAT-0017. Path/command/Git/domain policy and the audit-trail capability are useful for foreground runs alone. Background-specific policy does need FEAT-0017, but it is a subset. Forcing the whole feature behind FEAT-0017 means policy-grade tools cannot land for foreground use until durable runs ship.
recommendation: Either split FEAT-0021 into a foreground-policy slice (no FEAT-0017 dependency) and a background-policy slice (depends on FEAT-0017), or keep one feature but document explicit phasing in §Success Criteria so the foreground slice can start earlier.
disposition_rationale: Relaxed FEAT-0021 by moving FEAT-0017 from depends-on to related and adding an explicit foreground-policy-first success criterion.

summary: Workspace mode names diverge from FEAT-0015's canonical identifiers.
detail: FEAT-0015 defines snake_case identifiers (current, current_readonly, worktree, temp_copy, remote). FEAT-0021 uses prose forms (current workspace, read-only current workspace, Git worktree, temp copy, remote sandbox). Same set, different surface form.
recommendation: Use the snake_case identifiers from FEAT-0015 verbatim in FEAT-0021 §Workspace-Aware Execution.
disposition_rationale: Changed FEAT-0021 workspace names to the canonical FEAT-0015 snake_case identifiers.

summary: promoted-from: FEAT-0015 is redundant with parent: FEAT-0015.
disposition_rationale: Removed promoted-from: FEAT-0015 from the child feature frontmatter.
